brief: Attend to the cooling system where the fan contactor is chattering under load and the cooling stage is cycling intermittently. Because the unit is an ageing asset with two prior heat-related faults and an unverified cooling system due to its maintenance interval, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure if the condition cannot be attended before the event, in accordance with MG-023. Cite MG-021, MG-023, and REG-042.
